$comment: Owner: hep-detector. contracts 3.11.0, detector system design spec ART-60..ART-64: one evaluation per candidate x figure of merit x fidelity. fidelity, bound and parameter_refs are set by the tool contract of the operation the producing computational-run (run_ref) executed, and value equals the number in that run's output file; contracts/design.py checks all of them (design.contract_mismatch) and does not trust validity (FID-10). An F0 evaluation is labelled heuristic-argument; an unavailable evaluation carries no value and no run. The envelope inputs bind every candidate file of the derived_from chain, the run and the upstream evaluations.

uncertainty.$comment: OQ-06: minus/plus half-widths at the declared coverage; interval central (two-sided) or one-sided; distribution gaussian (coverage may be converted), non-gaussian, or exact (counting quantities: Clopper-Pearson or another exact interval)

validity.$comment: informational only (FID-10): design.py rechecks the validity domain from the contract

unavailable.$comment: capability.unavailable (RUL-01, ART-63): no evaluator for this figure of merit at this fidelity; bound estimate, no value, no run

study_ref.$comment: F4: the Geant4 study record (a computational-run)

model_envelope.$comment: F4 (FID-05): the two ends of the spread between physics lists; not a sigma, each end is compared with the target on its own
